comportamentos: watermark centered on the paper itself, regardless of margins or the signature footer: present (it computes the page center from page.dimensions and stamps with no fixed offset)
centering independent of phrase length: present (the start point is derived from width_of and the rotation)
band sized to the paper at the stamp angle, with a margin from the edge (WATERMARK_PAPER_MARGIN) and shrink_to_fit so the text is never clipped, e.g. in landscape: missing
watermark_band(page_width, page_height, band_height, angle) method and the WATERMARK_* constants: missing
justificativa: The candidate centers the text on the page, but it does not derive a band from the paper or limit or shrink the text to fit it, so a long phrase or landscape paper can still be clipped, and the watermark_band method and constants the official fix exposes are absent.
